items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: You like Sash playing Star Ben South Stand?

ctx.x: That's his style. You know who played on his order? Who's that? The white boy got the band. What's his name now? Old, old, old musician. He'd be playing, making good money later. That's his name now. That's his name now. That's his name now. . You like Sash playing Star Ben South Stand?
But South Stand knew how to get along with the people, huh? I haven't think much of his playing.
No. He just had a good wonderful name. Mutt. Sash. Sash is good. Sweet. That's his star. If it ain't him, it's somebody much just like him.
